summary: Senedd Research published a briefing in July 2026 on how Wales will manage a rapidly growing data centre industry. It reported 154 MW of data centre capacity in Wales in 2024, two UK Government AI Growth Zones in North and South Wales, and Department for Energy Security and Net Zero analysis that data centre electricity use in south-west England and Wales doubled between 2020 and 2024. It identified energy demand, grid capacity, water use for cooling, planning policy and community impacts as issues for Wales.
title: Senedd Research briefing on data centres in Wales: two AI Growth Zones and doubling electricity use raise energy, grid and water questions
